'''Daniel Czech''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2002 St. Anthony tournament]] in April 2002 with Tatooine Racing, according to Alexandre Dufresne's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3612">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-28-coaches-corner-8-27-02d3612/ coaches-corner-8-27-02], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 28 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-28-coaches-corner-8-27-02d3612/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
